purpose: Two additions to cmig_revision: (1) target_only calibration design using 16384 target pixels only, to separate recalibration from neural adaptation; (2) strong_blur factor at sigma=5.0 model-input pixels (resize-then-blur) for a more decisive sensitivity check. No new physical data collected.

target_only_calibration.rationale: Baseline: can the supervised-adaptation gain be matched by refitting the calibration head on target-domain frames only, without changing any model weights?

strong_blur_factor.rationale: Original sigma=1.5 produced negligible MAE changes (<0.5 mm in most seeds). sigma=5.0 provides a stronger intervention comparable to lens contamination or image compression artifacts.

scoring: Separate extension_comparison_summary.json; combined with cmig_revision heads in combined_summary.json.
